plan.data: Sheetpedia workbooks from the archive region after the first 620 MB (disjoint from the development and held-out sets, from the first 500 MB, and from confirmation set 1, 540-585 MB), shuffled with seed 2025, first 300 loadable workbooks with formulas, up to 25 formulas each; the extended verifier of baselines/Verification.v2.1.js (v2 plus a #REF!/#NAME? literal rule and an INDIRECT sheet-name rule)
plan.primary: share of formulas rejected by the shipped verifier (v1) and by GroundCheck (v2), with a workbook-clustered bootstrap interval
plan.secondary: rejection categories, agreement of rejections with the independent engine, flag rate, where the two verifiers disagree
plan.rule: scored once with the frozen verifier; no verifier change is made after seeing these results, and any defect found is reported as a limitation
